_comment: Pinned community content. 'sources' are skill texts copied to community/vendor/<id>/ and routed by skills/ads-community (not registered as skills). 'bundles' are whole companion plugins copied to bundles/<name>/, shipped inside this repo, and installed automatically with the ads plugin (Claude Code dependencies) or via the Codex marketplace. Only MIT / Apache-2.0, text files only. Sync with scripts/sync_community.py. The God Mode write gate applies regardless of which skill is active.

sources.role: Meta delivery-system mechanics: breakdown effect, learning phase, auction overlap, pacing, relevance diagnostics, performance fluctuations.

Sixteen ad-creative skills: five write copy (hooks, primary text, search headlines, offer/proof lines, funnel variants), eleven judge it (fatigue read, test readout, early-signal cut, losing-ad diagnosis, winner teardown, claim safety, ad-to-landing match).
Google Ads analysis, audit and math. (Its write and MCP skills are intentionally not vendored: Google writes go through this plugin's gated writer.)
Pre-flight ad policy check and claims gate (substantiation of every claim before it ships).
Meta Marketing API write discipline: rate limits, error codes, write rules that avoid integrity flags.

reference_only.why: Not vendored: Commons Clause restricts selling; link only.
Not vendored: no license grants reuse; link only.

bundles.name: agrici-ads
bundles.not_included: Python core (claude_ads_core), scripts, control-plane, cockpit mod, tests. Features that call them (image generation, page fetch, cockpit publish) need the upstream plugin.
bundles.role: 12-platform paid-media audits, plans, creative workflows and specialist audit agents.

bundles.name: marketing-skills
bundles.not_included: tools/ (CLI integrations), tests, eval suites, HTML asset templates.
bundles.role: 40+ marketing skills: paid ads, ad creative, attribution, conversion tracking, CRO, copywriting, A/B testing, launch.

bundles.name: meta-ads-genius
bundles.not_included: scripts/ (read-only Marketing API pulls). Its skills also work from CSV exports or the official Meta Ads MCP.
bundles.role: Meta analysis, opportunity spotting, optimization and campaign-management playbooks plus a read-only auditor agent.

optional_plugins.name: adplane
optional_plugins.why: Hosted connector (Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok) that sends account data to Adplane. Never auto-installed; offered by /ads:setup only.
